full_sentence: So, first of all, to make sure we are all on the same page, what do we mean when we talk about a tiny home or a tiny house?
And that seamlessly brings me to the second advantage.
Dear colleagues, dear students, to conclude, I think it is safe to say we live in a time where bigger is often presented as better.
Bigger homes, but also bigger cars, bigger careers, bigger biceps, bigger booties.
The tiny house movement shows us that it is all about priorities and having the guts to ask ourselves: what is actually enough?
